    // Who we are

    Teaching is a room,
    not a video library.

    We started in 2022 with one live room and twelve people. The format has not changed, only the number of rooms.

    Every instructor here still practises. Sessions are capped so questions get answered, and everything is recorded so nobody loses the material.
